scenes.title: Fire Alarm
scenes.summary: A fire inspector visits the kitchen of Claude Monet, criticizing the lack of visible fire extinguishers and giving Chef Barinov two days to fix the violations.

scenes.title: An Accidental Call
scenes.summary: The fire inspector returns repeatedly to find new faults with the extinguishers until Chef Barinov learns that the rival restaurant next door called in the tip.

scenes.title: Strike Back
scenes.summary: Furious at his rivals at Arcobaleno, Chef Barinov declares war and calls the migration service with a dramatic complaint to retaliate against the neighboring restaurant.

scenes.title: Curious Max
scenes.summary: In the kitchen, Max approaches Chef Barinov during a five-minute break, asking what he is cooking and hoping to learn from him and taste the dish.

scenes.title: The Secret Pâté
scenes.summary: Max tastes Chef Viktor's signature homemade pâté and is amazed by the flavor, boldly betting that he can deduce the secret recipe and recreate it by tonight.

scenes.title: Call to the Inspection
scenes.summary: Watching out the window as migration service inspectors raid Arcobaleno, Chef Viktor gloats to Senya about his anonymous complaint and celebrates his petty revenge.

scenes.title: The First Taste
scenes.summary: Max gives Kostya the first sample of his attempted copycat pâté, listening to Kostya's candid critique of its strange color and unrefined taste.

scenes.title: Whose Pâté is Better
scenes.summary: Kostya tries to tell Max about the police inspection next door, but an obsessive Max insists on knowing whether his pâté beats the chef's, receiving a blunt answer.

scenes.title: Inspection at the Rivals
scenes.summary: A migration inspector finishes his check at Elena's restaurant. He is very impressed. He says there are no illegal workers. They decide to eat at Claude Monet.

scenes.title: Escape Through the Hall
scenes.summary: Viktor tells the kitchen staff to leave through the back and front doors. But the back door is blocked. An immigration major introduces himself to Viktor.

scenes.title: Hunter of Illegals
scenes.summary: Viktor says he needs to work. Lanovsky starts monologuing about how people call him a scary person because he hunts people without documents.

scenes.title: Rats in the Fridge
scenes.summary: Lanovsky compares people without documents to rats. He gets a phone call saying they found them in the fridge. He tells Viktor to come with him.

scenes.title: In Search of the Key
scenes.summary: Viktor Petrovich is asked to open the fridge. He pretends to need the spare key.

scenes.title: The Lost Key
scenes.summary: The kitchen staff feigns ignorance about the lost key until Chef produces a spare.

scenes.title: Fedya's Release
scenes.summary: Fedya is released from the fridge after the inspection. Max continues to obsess over the pâté recipe.

scenes.title: Aynura Spice
scenes.summary: Another illegal worker is hidden. The inspector concludes the kitchen is clean. Max offers his pâté.

scenes.title: Apple Strudel
scenes.summary: In the dining room, the migration inspector sits down with Aynura disguised as a guest. Though he realizes she is an undocumented worker, the delicious apple strudel convinces him to spare her.

scenes.title: Method of Deduction
scenes.summary: The migration inspector approaches Louis in the dining room and deduces from his habits that he is actually a chef at the restaurant rather than a regular guest.

scenes.title: Document Check
scenes.summary: Having exposed Louis's disguise in the dining room, the migration inspector demands his papers and escorts the French pastry chef to Chef Barinov's office.

scenes.title: Fine and Deportation
scenes.summary: The migration inspector confronts Chef Barinov with the caught pastry chef, announcing a heavy fine for the restaurant and deportation for Louis.

scenes.title: Can I help
scenes.summary: The fire inspector is inspecting Claude Monet. The kitchen is in chaos. Let us see what happens next in this scene.

scenes.title: My duty
scenes.summary: The fire inspector makes a harsh decision. Let us see what happens next in this scene.

scenes.title: Exactly the Same
scenes.summary: Maks has been trying to recreate a special recipe. Maks approaches the Chef. Let us see what happens next in this scene.

scenes.title: Not My Pâté
scenes.summary: The Chef tastes the pâté that Maks prepared. Maks is waiting for a compliment. Let us see what happens next in this scene.

scenes.title: The Secret of the Pâté
scenes.summary: The Chef shows Maks the real ingredients of the famous pâté. Maks is completely shocked by what he sees. Let us see what happens next in this scene.
